name: Zywrap AI – Promptless Content Generation for WordPress
author: zywrap

sections.description:
Zywrap AI connects your WordPress site to the Zywrap API platform, enabling automatic content generation using reusable AI wrappers instead of manual prompt writing.

Instead of crafting prompts or maintaining prompt templates, Zywrap uses predefined, production-grade AI wrappers designed for real-world use cases such as blog writing, marketing copy, product descriptions, SEO content, and structured business text.

You select a wrapper, provide input (or no input at all), and generate consistent, high-quality content directly inside the WordPress editor.

Zywrap is ideal for developers, marketers, and content teams who want reliable AI outputs without trial-and-error prompt engineering.

Video Tutorial

Watch the full setup and usage walkthrough:

This video shows how to install the Zywrap plugin, connect your API key, sync wrappers, and generate prompt-free AI content directly inside WordPress.

Features

  • Promptless AI content generation using pre-built wrappers
  • Native integration with Gutenberg (Block Editor) and Classic Editor
  • One-click content insertion at the cursor position
  • Wrapper Playground for testing and experimentation
  • Preset system to save favorite wrapper configurations
  • Full admin dashboard with usage statistics
  • Secure, transaction-safe syncing of wrappers and models
  • Support for posts, pages, and custom post types
  • Separate system and usage logging
  • Optimized with caching for admin performance

External Services

This plugin connects to the Zywrap API to generate AI content.

Service: Zywrap API
Endpoint: https://api.zywrap.com
Purpose: Wrapper syncing, AI content generation, usage tracking
Data Sent: API key, wrapper codes, selected models, user-provided inputs

Terms of Service: https://zywrap.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://zywrap.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the zywrap folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Open the new “Zywrap” menu in the admin sidebar
  4. Go to Settings and enter your Zywrap API key (Sign up at Zywrap.com to get free credits)
  5. Click “Test Key” to verify your connection
  6. Click “Download & Sync Wrapper Bundle”
  7. Open the editor or Playground and start generating content
sections.faq:
Do I need a Zywrap account?

Yes. Zywrap AI is a connector plugin for the Zywrap API platform. You must have an active Zywrap account and API key.

Where does the Zywrap button appear?

Gutenberg: Open the (⋮) More menu in the top-right corner and select “Zywrap AI”.
Classic Editor: The Zywrap AI button appears next to the “Add Media” button.

Does this work with Custom Post Types?

Yes. You can enable Zywrap AI for any public post type from Zywrap → Settings.

Do I need to write prompts?

No. Wrappers already contain optimized instructions. You only provide task-specific input when required.

Is the generated content editable?

Yes. All generated content is inserted directly into the editor and can be edited like normal WordPress content.
